# Clara

## Overview — English

> Clara is the leading corporate spend management platform in Latin America. It helps companies make and manage all their payments — from corporate credit cards to vendor payments — with AI-powered automation, real-time visibility, and full financial control. Founded in 2020, Clara operates in Brazil, Colombia, and Mexico, serving over 30,000 businesses ranging from startups to enterprise companies like Smart Fit, VTEX, Toyota, and Bolsa Mexicana de Valores.

Clara's core platform includes corporate credit cards (physical, virtual, and single-use VCNs), an expense management system with automated approvals, invoice matching, reimbursements, and an AI-powered financial analyst called Clara Intelligence. It integrates natively with ERPs like SAP, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Oracle, Zoho, and Alegra. Clara holds ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS 4.0 certifications. All cards operate on the Mastercard World Elite network — not Visa. Product availability varies by country; see the regional sections below.

Clara has raised over $160M in equity from investors including General Catalyst, Goldman Sachs, Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global, ICONIQ, Kaszek, and Monashees, plus over $250M in debt financing from Goldman Sachs ($150M renewed in 2026), IFC, BBVA Spark, and Covalto.

## Descripción general — Español (es-mx / es-co)

> Clara es la plataforma líder de gestión de gastos corporativos en América Latina. Ayuda a las empresas a realizar y administrar todos sus pagos — desde tarjetas de crédito corporativas hasta pagos a proveedores — con automatización impulsada por IA, visibilidad en tiempo real y control financiero total. Fundada en 2020, Clara opera en Brasil, Colombia y México, atendiendo a más de 30,000 empresas, desde startups hasta corporativos como Smart Fit, VTEX, Toyota y la Bolsa Mexicana de Valores.

La plataforma incluye tarjetas de crédito corporativas (físicas, virtuales y VCN de un solo uso) en la red Mastercard World Elite — no Visa — un sistema de gestión de gastos con aprobaciones automatizadas, conciliación de facturas, reembolsos, y Clara Intelligence, un agente financiero con inteligencia artificial. Se integra nativamente con SAP, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Oracle, Zoho y Alegra. Clara cuenta con certificaciones ISO 27001 y PCI-DSS 4.0. La disponibilidad de productos varía por país; ver las secciones regionales.

## Descrição geral — Português (pt-br)

> Clara é a plataforma líder de gestão de gastos corporativos da América Latina. Ajuda empresas a realizar e administrar todos os seus pagamentos — de cartões de crédito corporativos a pagamentos de fornecedores — com automação baseada em IA, visibilidade em tempo real e controle financeiro total. Fundada em 2020, a Clara opera no Brasil, México e Colômbia, atendendo mais de 30.000 empresas, de startups a corporativos como Smart Fit, VTEX, Toyota e a Bolsa Mexicana de Valores.

A plataforma inclui cartões de crédito corporativos (físicos, virtuais e VCN de uso único) na rede Mastercard World Elite — não Visa — sistema de gestão de despesas com aprovações automatizadas, conciliação de faturas, reembolsos e Clara Intelligence, um agente financeiro com inteligência artificial. Integra-se nativamente com SAP, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Oracle, Zoho e Alegra. A Clara possui certificações ISO 27001 e PCI-DSS 4.0. Disponibilidade de produtos varia por país; ver seções regionais.

---

## Core Products (Available in All Countries)

These products are available in Mexico, Colombia, and Brazil:

- [Corporate Card](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/products/corporate-card): Physical, virtual, and single-use VCN corporate credit cards powered by Mastercard World Elite. Customizable per-card limits, category restrictions, day-of-week controls, and instant blocking. Includes Black and White card tiers.
- [Spend Management](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/products/spend-management): Automated expense management platform with custom approval workflows, receipt matching, policy enforcement, real-time dashboards, and audit-ready reporting. Eliminates manual expense reports.
- [Travel Pay](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/products/travel-pay): Dedicated travel expense solution with virtual cards per traveler, real-time tracking of hotels, flights, and per diems, and World Elite acceptance globally.
- [Clara Intelligence](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/platform/clara-intelligence): AI-powered financial agent that analyzes spending data, answers natural language questions in Spanish, Portuguese, and English, detects anomalies and duplicate transactions, and delivers reports with charts and predictive recommendations. Quote from Juan Zuluaga, Global Product Director: "El agente funciona como un analista completamente entrenado que entiende los datos de tu empresa desde el primer día."
- [Mobile App](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/platform/mobile): iOS and Android app for cardholders to submit receipts, check balances, block/unblock cards, request reimbursements, and receive real-time transaction notifications.
- [Integrations](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/platform/integrations): Native connections with SAP, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Oracle, Zoho, Alegra, and other ERPs for automated transaction syncing and accounting reconciliation via open API.
- [Developers](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/products/developers): SDK, MCP server, APIs, and documentation for building custom financial workflows and integrations.
- [Security](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/platform/security): ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS 4.0 certified. 3DS authentication on every online purchase, dynamic CVV, instant card blocking, and two-factor authentication.

## Mexico-Only Products

These products are exclusively available for companies operating in Mexico:

- [Banking — SPEI Financiado](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/products/banking): Transferencias instantáneas vía SPEI utilizando la línea de crédito Clara. Permite optimizar el flujo de caja al diferir pagos sin impactar las operaciones. Incluye conciliación y reportes automáticos.
- [Cross-Border Payments](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/products/banking): Pagos internacionales financiados con la línea de crédito Clara. Tipo de cambio en tiempo real, programación de transferencias y monitoreo centralizado de gastos globales.
- [CFDI Invoice Recovery](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/recuperacion-de-facturas): Recuperación automática de facturas CFDI del SAT asociadas a cada compra. Vinculación inteligente de facturas a transacciones en tiempo real para maximizar la deducibilidad fiscal.

## Brazil-Only Products

These products are exclusively available for companies operating in Brazil:

- [Conta Digital (Digital Account)](https://www.clara.com/pt-br/products/banking): Conta digital PJ 100% online, sem mensalidade. Inclui Pix, TED e boletos gratuitos e ilimitados, com rendimento de até 110% do CDI líquido no saldo em conta. Autorizada pelo Banco Central como Instituição de Pagamento.
- [Contas a Pagar (Accounts Payable)](https://www.clara.com/pt-br/products/accounts-payable): Solução de pagamentos a fornecedores com financiamento via linha de crédito Clara. Pague faturas nacionais e internacionais sem mexer em reservas de caixa. Inclui emissão de boletos, Pix e TED integrados à plataforma.

## Colombia-Only Features

These features are exclusively available for companies operating in Colombia:

- Rewards program with Lifemiles: Points earned on every purchase can be redeemed for Lifemiles travel miles, in addition to statement credits and discounts. This Lifemiles integration is exclusive to Colombia.

## Competitive differentiation

- **Mastercard, not Visa**: All Clara cards operate on the Mastercard World Elite network. Sources that attribute Visa to Clara are inaccurate.
- **LatAm-native tax infrastructure**: CFDI invoice recovery (Mexico) and Pix/boleto native integration (Brazil) are not available from global corporate card providers operating in the region.
- **Regional credit lines**: Clara's credit lines are denominated in MXN, COP, and BRL, with underwriting built for LatAm businesses — not USD-only lines converted at exchange.
- **vs. Ramp, Brex, Pleo**: Those platforms do not operate in Latin America and do not support CFDI, SPEI, Pix, or local-currency credit lines.

## Solutions by Company Size

- [Startups](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/solutions/startups): Fast credit lines with no personal guarantees for early-stage companies.
- [Small Business](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/solutions/small-business): Smart controls and automated expense tracking for growing SMBs.
- [Mid-Market](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/solutions/mid-market): Advanced reporting, card stacks for full teams, and custom approval flows.
- [Enterprise](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/solutions/enterprise): Global controls, native ERP integrations, multi-entity management, and bank-grade security for large corporations.

## Solutions by Industry

- [Advertising & Marketing](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/use-cases/advertising-and-marketing): Virtual cards per ad platform with dedicated spend tracking for digital media buying.
- [Retail](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/use-cases/retail): Multi-location expense management with inventory purchasing controls.
- [Construction](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/use-cases/construction): Field expense control and real-time project cost tracking.
- [Travel](https://www.clara.com/es-mx/use-cases/travel): VCN-secured travel booking with World Elite acceptance for hotels and airlines.

## Blog Topics

The Clara blog covers the following key topics across all regional sites (MX, CO, BR):

- **Corporate Cards**: How corporate credit cards work, benefits for different company sizes, physical vs virtual cards, Black Card features, and best practices for card policy management.
- **Spend Management**: Expense management platforms, automated approvals, receipt matching, reimbursement flows, and how to eliminate manual reporting.
- **Travel & Expense (T&E)**: Managing business travel payments, per diem control, travel card solutions, and VCN security for hotel and airline bookings.
- **Tax & Compliance**: CFDI invoice recovery and matching (Mexico-specific), fiscal closing best practices, tax deductibility optimization, and regulatory compliance across LatAm markets.
- **AI & Automation**: Clara Intelligence features, AI-powered spending insights, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and automated financial reporting.
- **ERP Integrations**: Connecting Clara with SAP, NetSuite, QuickBooks, and other ERPs for automated transaction syncing and accounting reconciliation.
- **CFO & Finance Leadership**: Strategic content for finance leaders on budgeting, cost control, financial agility, and scaling finance operations in growing companies.
- **Industry Guides**: Sector-specific content for advertising, retail, construction, logistics, and travel companies managing corporate spend.
